task: Integrate Team A straight-line local ownership facts into native generator local-alias lowering.
observation: The native emitter successfully consumed TypedLocalOwnershipFactV1 and exact EST occurrence facts from Team A. By lowering Effect::Read aliases to shared borrows (&origin) and Effect::Write to mutable borrows (&mut origin), previously failing non-Copy local alias patterns now compile cleanly with rustc and achieve full output parity with Fast Debug without clones. Fail-closed behavior on fact drop/perturb was verified end-to-end.
impact: Migrated the first production native path to checker-owned local ownership facts, preserving the single semantic authority invariant and verifying fail-closed invariants under drop/perturbation.

resolution.summary: Native generator consumes TypedLocalOwnershipFactV1 for straight-line local aliases, validating definition identity, EST occurrence, specialization, and availability, and failing closed on missing or perturbed facts.
